entries.subject: C1138148 surface registration
entries.finding: The existing registration record states that the photograph remains coarse limb-pointed evidence without independently controlled surface features, so the photographic surface stays deferred.
entries.revisitWhen: A Larissa camera or surface-control release supports independent interior holdouts from a different viewing geometry.

entries.subject: Voyager ISS archive, C1138148
entries.finding: Selected for the retained coarse Monochrome lens: calibrated GEOMED clear frame C1138148, about 3.54 km per corrected pixel (4.18 km/native pixel), with only roughly 50–60 samples across the visible disc. Limb-pointed registration is not independent surface-feature control; photographic terrain qualification remains deferred in the separate registration entry.

entries.subject: C1138142 and C1138153
entries.finding: Inspected archive frames. Excluded: repeated similar coverage or much coarser wide-angle sampling; no distinct dataset or useful added detail.
entries.revisitWhen: A Larissa observation or controlled reconstruction demonstrates useful native surface detail, body-fixed geometry and independent registration beyond the cited sampling or coverage limits.

entries.subject: USGS/PDS mapping, colour, composition and altimetry searches
entries.finding: No additional registered scientific layer was qualified. Global radius values are a coarse shape reconstruction and must not be presented as an observed high-resolution DEM.
entries.revisitWhen: A Larissa source release provides the missing downloadable mapped data, projection, measured quantity and coverage for direct comparison with the selected inputs.

entries.subject: Stooke n7larissa.tab radius grid
entries.finding: The PDS 5-degree west-positive radius grid supplies shape and radius-relative Elevation above 96 km. It preserves the published origin and modeled unseen shape; broad figure, exaggerated facets and depressions are not local altimetry or a high-resolution terrain survey.

entries.subject: Stooke shaded-relief drawings
entries.finding: Interpretive shaded-relief drawings are not adopted as photographic imagery; the independently documented numeric radius grid remains the selected shape input.
entries.revisitWhen: A measured photographic or scalar product supplies its original pixels or values, coverage and body-fixed registration.
